findings.lane_arithmetic: PASS: every signed12 raw code is reconstructed as {high4,low8}; every signed8 raw code is sign-extended to signed12; all 96 lane positions participate in each transaction.
findings.delta_only_semantics: PASS: the module port list has no old_psum, correction, or seed_fusion operand. contribution_data is update_delta only, so the M427r3 revocation remains intact and downstream must compute old_psum+delta.
findings.elastic_fifo: PASS: randomized stalls, a 16-cycle directed stall, 643 simultaneous pop+push cycles, and independent ordered scoreboard showed no loss, duplicate, reorder, metadata drift, or data drift in legal operation.
findings.fail_closed: PASS: all four duplicated wide metadata fields, low/middle/high padding witnesses, all five narrow high-side categories, concurrent reload/request, busy reload, and malformed request while an older output was ready were suppressed in the violating cycle and remained sticky-quiescent until reset.
findings.accepted_retired_accounting: PASS WITH EXPLICIT RECOVERY CAVEAT: the original 309/308 delta is the one older accepted entry quarantined by the reload-busy attack and later discarded by explicit reset. M434 independently created two such fault cases and obtained 650-648=2 exactly. No legal non-fault transaction was silently dropped.
findings.bandwidth_fairness: PASS DISCLOSURE, NOT RESOURCE-NORMALIZED: a wide accept consumes 144 logical bytes and exposes 160 physical input bytes per cycle versus the frozen 96-byte SHARED96 port. This is a new throughput/area/interconnect point, never a free upgrade.
findings.evidence: PASS: original M433 and M427r3 inner/outer seals verify; M434 r1b recompiles RTL+SVA+independent TB with exact SHA under Synopsys VCS. The earlier r1 runner finalization failure is preserved and non-citeable; it failed after simulation only because its self-hash path was relative after cd, and r1b is the sole admitted run.

issues.finding: No DC/STA exists for M433. The combinational fail-closed path includes wide metadata/padding and narrow full-high-side legality, so II=1 functional behavior is not yet a 3 ns timing result.
issues.required_action: Run exact-SHA standalone DC/STA at the frozen 3 ns constraint and report logic-only area, setup, hold, and the legality-to-ready/valid critical paths.

issues.finding: RTL-to-netlist equivalence has not been measured.
issues.required_action: After DC, run Formality on observable sequential behavior, including simultaneous pop+push and sticky fault state; do not overclaim removed debug state.

issues.finding: The adapter is not yet connected to the 51.84M-row/full-population codec and accumulator, and its 160-byte physical interface is not normalized against SHARED96/K2 SRAM ports, wires, or power.
issues.required_action: Run full-population integration with old_psum+delta preserved, then compare serial96, dual144/160, and K2-192 under explicit port/macro/interconnect area and energy accounting.

issues.finding: A malformed request or illegal reload while an older output is buffered deliberately quarantines that accepted output; reset discards it. This is fail-stop, not transparent recovery.
issues.required_action: At integration, specify poison/rollback or window replay on protocol_error. Keep accepted-minus-retired fault discards separate from legal-throughput accounting.

issues.finding: The supplied SVA checks handshake, stickiness, stall stability, and covers, but exact lane arithmetic and FIFO ordering are procedural-scoreboard checks rather than temporal assertions.
issues.required_action: For full-population integration, retain an independent reference scoreboard or add a sampled request-to-output value property; do not rely on the current SVA alone as an arithmetic proof.
